rules: Task status is implementation/history state, not production approval. READY is derived from hard predecessors, never stored.
T00 and T26 historical completions are preserved. T00A closed the four post-merge dependency-policy findings in PR #12.
Web, iOS and Android including native digital purchases are required programme scope. T25 is multi-platform signoff.
Owned paths and artifacts are planned targets unless present in the code tree. Required document links must exist now.
Every task may use bounded sub-PRs; DONE requires the integrated acceptance evidence, not one merged scaffold.
Human gates permit mock/disabled implementation only where specified; no invented rights, participants, account access, test results or store approvals.
T07 is optional if omitted from marketed scope. Other-owner comparison requires T22 authorization before release.
No provider charges, recruitment, signing-account changes or public rollout without the applicable owner gate.

gate_registry.pilot_rights_consent: Owner-reviewed collection agreement, purpose/retention/withdrawal protocol before recruitment.
gate_registry.empirical_calibration: Actual writer-disjoint measurement error/coverage evidence and approved supported contexts.
gate_registry.traditional_content_if_enabled: Separate source/wording/eligibility approval before any traditional runtime activation.
gate_registry.design_acceptance: Owner acceptance of real contract-driven web/native/report design.
gate_registry.actual_participants_and_permissions: Real participant permissions, collection and protected annotation evidence; never agent-fabricated.
gate_registry.source_rights: Exact dataset/source/license and allowed-purpose decision before ingestion.
gate_registry.public_reference_validation: Qualified corpus/statistical validation before public rank/distinctiveness claims.
gate_registry.benchmark_promotion: Named approval of a still-authorized frozen reference release.
gate_registry.api_access_spend_before_live_calls: Approved model account, data controls and spend cap before live provider calls.
gate_registry.model_evaluation_and_data_controls: Actual model capability/safety/usefulness evaluation and data-processing approval before enablement.
gate_registry.price_account_terms_before_charges: Approved products/prices/accounts/tax/refund/storefront and portability policy before real charges.
gate_registry.processor_retention_contracts: Approved providers, regions, purposes, retention/deletion and support obligations.
gate_registry.public_release_signoff: Named owner approval of exact web/iOS/Android artifacts, scope and staged release.
gate_registry.interpretation_database_review: Historical T26 manual review recorded by its merged handoff; does not activate inference or traditional packs.
gate_registry.native_signing_accounts: Owner-authorized developer accounts, identifiers, signing custody and protected release credentials.
gate_registry.apple_store_review: Actual Apple/TestFlight/product/privacy review evidence and current requirements verified.
gate_registry.google_play_review: Actual Play testing/production-access/product/privacy review evidence and current account requirements verified.

empirical.description: Protected rights-cleared writer-disjoint evaluation; record actual artifacts, tolerances and outcomes, not synthetic proxy approvals.

web_render.description: Owning task adds generated-client/type tests, browser journeys, accessibility and report/PDF/card fact parity.

native.description: T29 establishes JS/native test commands and signed-build matrix; T30/T31 add real device and sandbox purchase/lifecycle evidence.

release.description: T23/T24/T32/T33 add real recovery, security, signed-store and rollout evidence; T25 requires human approval.

tasks.title: Product contracts and zero-AI capability manifest
tasks.completion_evidence: Merged PR #13 (merge 48d4e033d576211766d1d98a65061452b4b199e9); exact head 1de5a3dde7d4a7317a7a2714bc79a15aa24d4032 passed CI run 36280551268 and roadmap run 36280551264; main CI run 36281080920 passed after merge. Codex security review of that head completed with no findings; no code-review finding was posted.
coding_steps: Author versioned JSON Schemas for AnalysisReference, EvidenceBundle, ReportDocument/ViewModel, Comparison, Premium packet/output, grants, exports and entitlement-facing DTOs; preserve the canonical numerical schema.
Pin and implement generation of Python/TypeScript DTOs and derive/check API schema compatibility from the same source. Define canonical hashes, time/ID/currency/missingness formats.

Provide positive/negative fixtures for partial/no-reference/locked/pending/revoked states and a consumer handoff manifest.
tasks.contract_handoff: Frozen wire schemas, generated DTOs, fixtures and version/compatibility policy used by backend, web, mobile, renderer and Premium.

Free executes without provider credentials, learned weights or provider egress; unavailable methods return explicit reasons.
Region/run/evidence references and finite canonical values are validated.
negative_tests: NaN/Infinity, boolean-as-number, wrong unit/owner/run, unknown enum, missing-as-zero, learned transitive dependency, incompatible schema major.
artifacts: Product schemas and generated DTOs
Method capability manifest and isolation fixtures
Contract version/migration guide

tasks.title: Persistence identity authorization
coding_steps: Implement initial principal/identity, asset/sample/capture, run/measurement/region, report, job/outbox and version tables with reviewed Alembic migrations; defer commerce-specific tables to T19.

Implement an append-only permission/consent event ledger and owner-scoped grant/withdraw lifecycle for service processing, retention, third-party AI processing, contribution, ordinary sharing and partner comparison as distinct purposes, using T03 purpose/policy IDs; check effective permission at use time rather than mutating historical grants.
Map verified provider identities to internal principals; implement guest-to-account transfer and deletion/session revocation. No home-grown password system or email-only account linking.
Persist canonical result JSON and relational projections atomically; enforce owner/run composite references and actual non-owner runtime roles.
Publish authenticated API composition and repository/unit-of-work fakes plus PostgreSQL integration fixtures.
tasks.contract_handoff: Stable internal ownership IDs, transaction boundaries and versioned persistence interfaces; no provider objects leak into DTOs.
acceptance: Cross-owner/run access and duplicate features are rejected by application and relevant database constraints.
Actual PostgreSQL role/RLS and migration/restore smoke pass; reference members remain service-only.
Permission grants/withdrawals persist as append-only purpose/policy/scope events; stale or withdrawn permission cannot authorize later processing.
Partner-comparison authorization is a separate purpose from ordinary sharing, with independent grant/withdraw/audit state checked at use time.
negative_tests: Guessed report IDs, forged region parent, guest-transfer race, revoked token, duplicate projection write and migration rollback with existing rows.
Permission replay, stale policy version, concurrent withdraw/use, contribution without authority and AI processing after withdrawal.
Ordinary share grant reused as partner-comparison authority, withdrawn partner comparison reused by a stale invitation, and concurrent partner withdrawal/use.
artifacts: Migrations, repositories/unit of work and identity adapter
Owner-scoped API and non-owner role tests
Permission-event schema/repository/service and grant/withdraw API lifecycle
rollback: Use expand/contract migrations and revoke provider bindings safely; never restore deleted ownership from a stale cache.

tasks.title: Rights consent and collection protocol
tasks.completion_evidence: Merged PR #12 with T00A at the same exact head and CI/review evidence. Draft protocol contracts only: the pilot_rights_consent gate stays pending, no approval, participant or source clearance exists, and recruitment remains T11.
coding_steps: Draft purpose-specific consent/withdrawal, retention and source-license contracts without inventing approvals; define partner comparison as a distinct purpose from ordinary sharing, and coordinate final DTO mapping with T01.
Prepare original Swedish/English controlled/free-writing prompts and capture/author guidance, keeping copied tasks separate from free writing and repeat captures separate from writers.
Specify deletion lineage, participant/source rights evidence, adult eligibility and unsupported context handling for owner review.
Provide fixtures for grant/deny/withdraw/no-authority cases and a gated pilot handoff; actual recruitment belongs to T11.
tasks.contract_handoff: Versioned purpose/protocol IDs and approved-or-pending evidence references; service permission, contribution, AI processing, ordinary sharing and partner comparison are distinct purposes.
acceptance: Declining contribution does not reduce Free; no prechecked sharing/donation.
Source code, data and model-weight rights are distinguished; retention is a reviewed configuration, not a legal claim.
negative_tests: Payment mistaken for AI consent, uploader lacks author permission, withdrawal during use, reused obsolete notice, duplicate specimen counted as a writer.
artifacts: Draft consent/retention/source-rights specifications
Original collection prompts and protocol fixtures
rollback: Version notices/protocols; revoke future uses without silently changing the meaning of historical grants.

tasks.title: Safe intake and durable analysis jobs
coding_steps: Implement owner/quota-bound upload reservation and completion, media sniffing, bounded decode/sanitization and tested mobile-format conversion policy.
Promote verified bytes to an immutable internal asset/version before scheduling; retain digest and coordinate-transform lineage.

Expose `POST /v1/analyses` as the explicit idempotent transition from a completed immutable sample/capture to one deterministic AnalysisRun/job; upload completion validates/promotes bytes but does not silently create a run.
Implement PostgreSQL job/outbox, short lease/heartbeat, attempt records and fenced publication outside long transactions.
Provide owner-scoped status/cancel/delete behavior and safe failure codes; restrict CPU/memory/provider egress and admission cost.
tasks.contract_handoff: An immutable authorized capture and durable AnalysisRun/job reference; source bytes and processed frame are never conflated.
acceptance: Repeated completion/submission converges on one intended result.
Stale workers and delete-during-run cannot publish; Free is bounded and provider independent.
negative_tests: Pixel bomb, spoofed MIME, animated/malformed file, HEIC orientation, signed-URL overwrite race, checksum mismatch, expired upload, queue crash and stale lease.
artifacts: Safe intake routes and storage adapter
Durable analysis worker with limits/fencing
Failure/format compatibility fixtures
rollback: Stop admission and drain/fence leases; preserve verified inputs only under retention and never republish tombstoned captures.

tasks.title: Evidence payload and chart observations
coding_steps: Add an explicit versioned evidence output beside existing aggregate measurements; do not overload feature dictionary keys.
Capture actual baseline points, slant observations/bins, accepted spacing gaps and component distributions with region/frame references.
Bound array sizes and preserve deterministic ordering, transform maps, accepted/rejected provenance and missing reasons.
Provide report-ready fixtures and verify evidence-derived summaries against canonical aggregate calculations.
tasks.contract_handoff: EvidenceBundle tied to one run/schema/configuration, with real observations and original-to-analysis transform metadata.
acceptance: Overlay coordinates round-trip across crop/resize/deskew and supported perspective operations.
Histograms are based on observations, not fabricated curves; numerical feature semantics are unchanged.
negative_tests: Empty evidence, cross-frame region, invalid run link, nonfinite point, huge arrays, false page margin and mutable shared image.
artifacts: Evidence emitters, schema fixtures and transform tests
rollback: Version the evidence extension; retain compatibility with aggregate-only stored runs and label unavailable evidence.

tasks.title: Calibration suitability core repair
coding_steps: Freeze annotated geometry, writer-disjoint splits, coverage/error measures and tolerances before held-out evaluation.
Measure page boundaries, segmentation, x-height, baseline, slant, spacing and image-proxy repeatability across declared capture/script contexts.
Repair demonstrated errors with method/configuration versioning; preserve original evidence and annotator disagreement.
Publish a capability/calibration release defining where estimates remain experimental, unavailable or sufficiently validated.
tasks.contract_handoff: Actual calibration artifacts and supported-context policy consumed by display/reference/model gates.
acceptance: Real authorized held-out evidence, actual counts and error/coverage results are recorded.
Confidence appears only when calibrated; repeat-photo variation is not writer variation.
negative_tests: Leaked writer splits, tuned holdout, cropped-page margins, weak x-height invalidating ratios, unsupported script, spurious confidence from sample count.
artifacts: Protected evaluation release and method repair evidence
Versioned suitability/calibration policy
rollback: Disable affected claims and revert to the last supported method version; do not pool incompatible outputs into a reference.

tasks.title: Bounded classical topology shape expansion
coding_steps: Select one classical family only when a report use case justifies it; do not chase all 272 definitions.
Implement topology/shape estimates behind capability/evidence contracts and exact canonical semantics.
Add synthetic topology invariants and real supported-image robustness evidence before enabling claims.
tasks.contract_handoff: A bounded versioned feature-family addition with explicit availability and evidence.
acceptance: Feature ID/unit/scale/domain and dependency closure match the source schema.
Omitting this task from initial marketed scope does not block public v1.
negative_tests: Invented pen lifts/timing/physical pressure from a static image, disconnected skeleton noise, missing evidence treated as a negative trait.
artifacts: One-family extractors and tests
Updated method/capability documentation
rollback: Disable/revert the family with explicit method version; keep definition-only outputs unavailable.

tasks.title: Normalization and reviewed content
coding_steps: Implement fixed versioned mechanical display axes with domains, family weights and missingness; do not use per-user auto-max normalization.
Add authored deterministic captions/geometric style labels and localization keys tied to evidence.
Keep traditional packs inactive unless exact source/wording/runtime eligibility is separately approved; T26 structure does not supply active rules automatically.
tasks.contract_handoff: Normalization/content release IDs and deterministic outputs for T09/T13/T18.
acceptance: Monotonicity, unit/scale equivalence and partial-dependency behavior are tested.
No arbitrary psychological weights or double-counted correlated summaries; evidence labels travel to every view.
negative_tests: Zero denominator, constant scale, missing axis plotted zero, repeated signal overweighting, unsupported traditional inversion.
artifacts: Versioned formulas/caption pack and localization fixtures
rollback: Pin content/normalization versions in saved reports; disable a pack without rewriting canonical facts.

tasks.title: Report assembly and authorized projections
coding_steps: Build pure immutable ReportDocument assembly from canonical results/evidence plus optional content/reference and saved Premium overlays.
Produce owner/Free/Premium/share projections through an explicit authorization context; do not embed hidden paid prose in Free JSON.
Define version/digest/revision rules, availability states and shared formatting/chart specs. Provide fixture-backed service seams before persistence integration.
Integrate repository-backed report endpoints in the backend/client tasks without moving measurement or billing authority into a renderer.
tasks.contract_handoff: Stable ReportDocument/ViewModel snapshots and read-only projection/formatting helpers used by all clients and export.
acceptance: Partial/no-reference/no-traditional reports are useful and honest.
Reads/expansion/export assembly never call a model; incompatible versions and cross-report evidence fail.
negative_tests: Foreign support ID, revoked image, stale entitlement, hidden paid JSON, missing-to-zero coercion and silently re-benchmarked history.
artifacts: Report assembler/projections and cross-client fixtures

tasks.title: Contract-driven multi-platform design handoff
coding_steps: Design the complete capture/report/paid/comparison/settings journey against generated DTO fixtures; use clearly synthetic states with no private provider upload.
Specify web DOM/print and native layout/interaction differences, shared tokens, chart text alternatives, accessibility and Swedish/English overflow behavior.
Produce component inventory, state transitions and a Claude Design/Code or equivalent handoff mapped to real properties; mark illustrative values.
Include native purchase pending/restore, refusal/refund, no-reference, revoked/deleted and export-preview states, not just a polished happy path.
tasks.contract_handoff: Owner-reviewed design tokens, reusable component boundaries and fixture/property mapping for T17/T21/T29–T31.
acceptance: Clickable responsive/native designs and accessible text/motion states are accepted by the owner.
No fake personalized blurred Premium text or unsupported rarity used to fill a layout.
negative_tests: Long Swedish text, large text scaling, empty data, denied permissions, unavailable purchase, no eligible benchmark and narrow/large screens.
artifacts: Design specification/prototype references
Tokens, component/state inventory and approved assets

tasks.title: Owned pilot recruitment and annotation
coding_steps: Build consented collection/annotation tooling and private evidence references; humans recruit actual eligible writers under approved terms.
Collect controlled/free specimens, repeated captures and declared context without turning pages/crops into independent people.
Create protected writer-disjoint annotation/evaluation splits, record recruitment bias and inter-annotator disagreement.
Exercise withdrawal/deletion before a corpus release; no participant images or signed consent documents enter public Git fixtures.
tasks.contract_handoff: A real rights-cleared pilot release with writer/specimen/capture lineage and annotation provenance, not synthetic recruitment counts.
acceptance: Actual permissions, protected splits and counts are inspectable by authorized reviewers.
Collection targets are planning inputs, never proof that enough representative writers exist.
negative_tests: Withdrawn participant, duplicate capture/writer, synthetic data in human set, insufficient author authority and holdout leakage.
artifacts: Protected pilot/annotation release and safe audit summary
rollback: Quarantine affected records and propagate withdrawal; preserve only authorized audit references.

tasks.title: Candidate corpus ETL and deduplication
coding_steps: Ingest only approved source releases with archive/digest/license/purpose lineage and version-compatible extraction.
Group writer/specimen/capture and duplicate-review signals; select primary specimens by a predeclared rule independent of rarity.
Compute per-feature suitability/cohort masks and quarantine/review states. Reruns are idempotent and do not inflate N.
Expose release-candidate interfaces only to authorized reference roles, not user endpoints.
tasks.contract_handoff: Reproducible candidate membership, quality masks and rights lineage for T13/T14.
acceptance: Repeated/rotated captures cannot create new writers; perceptual matching is not authorship identification.
Rights-denied/withdrawn records cannot enter a candidate release.
negative_tests: Duplicate transform, mixed versions, missing permission, repeated ingestion, rare-but-valid sample wrongly excluded and cross-source duplicate.
artifacts: Candidate ETL/review pipeline and deduplication audit
rollback: Quarantine a source/release and rebuild descendants without reactivating withdrawn membership.

tasks.title: Reference statistics and distinctiveness
coding_steps: Implement tie-aware empirical CDF/rank with per-feature eligible unique-writer counts and exclusion of all query-writer samples.
Freeze cohort choice, quantization, uncertainty/coverage and headline-selection policy before looking for flattering outliers.
Calibrate selected-feature/multiplicity behavior and any distance/index mapping with held-out writers; do not multiply marginal rarities.
Return qualified reference fact DTOs and unavailable reasons for no-match/small/constant/unsupported contexts.
tasks.contract_handoff: Versioned reference facts/outliers selected by statistics code, never by the model.
acceptance: Ranks name their finite cohort/release and uncertainty; no population-wide claim from convenience data.
Replay from release artifacts produces the same facts and eligible counts.
negative_tests: Ties, constant features, empty N, query writer included, best-flattering cohort selection, correlated maximum and missing scale denominator.
artifacts: Statistical implementation, frozen selection plan and validation release
rollback: Withhold affected ranks and select only an authorized validated reference release; preserve historical revision labels.

tasks.title: Benchmark publish withdraw drift rollback
coding_steps: Implement candidate/build/review/publish/retire states with frozen cutoff, member/config/artifact hashes and human promotion.
Evaluate drift/composition and quality before atomically switching the active release pointer; do not rewrite saved reports.
Apply withdrawal lineage, in-flight consent rechecks, retirement/rebuild and tombstone-aware restoration.
Restrict rollback to still-authorized releases and record invalidated historical reference annotations explicitly.
tasks.contract_handoff: Approved benchmark release pointer and traceable retirement/withdrawal state.
acceptance: Consent revoked during build cannot be published; continuous ingestion does not mutate a release.
Rebuild/withdrawal/restore drills preserve privacy and reproducible lineage.
negative_tests: Poisoned duplicate batch, revoked member at publish, stale active pointer, backup resurrection and incompatible engine release.
artifacts: Release publisher and drift/withdrawal runbooks
rollback: Switch only to an authorized compatible release or disable reference claims; never resurrect a revoked cohort.

tasks.title: Evidence-bound OpenAI adapter
coding_steps: Retrieve only the authorized image/analysis derivative through the restricted ObjectStore port with scoped worker access; re-check consent/deletion before transfer and never expose a reusable storage credential to the model provider.
Assemble a bounded immutable packet from authorized image/evidence, eligible reference facts and T26 applicable question/candidate contracts.
Implement supported deterministic candidate producers and explicit unavailable states; compile per-request strict enums/output schema from frozen data.
Implement one bounded multimodal Responses request with server-only credentials and no hidden retry/tool/browse behavior; begin with fakes.
Validate shape, evidence, semantics and text bounds before a saved overlay; hand off reservation/publication integration to shared commerce rather than inventing a second ledger.
tasks.contract_handoff: PremiumRequestPacket, provider attempt/result and validated saved-overlay interfaces for T16/T19/T20/native clients.
acceptance: Image text is untrusted, model output cannot mutate canonical measurements or invent ranks.
Refusal/truncation/ambiguous timeout and no-reference cases are explicit; Free has no provider dependency.
negative_tests: Foreign support IDs, impossible enums, extra properties, fabricated numbers, prompt injection, stale consent, empty candidates and budget exhaustion.
artifacts: Packet/candidate/schema compiler, model adapter/fake and semantic validators
rollback: Disable new Premium attempts; preserve saved valid overlays and reconcile reserved credits without changing Free.

tasks.title: Model evaluation and generation policy
coding_steps: Freeze a human/adversarial rubric and expected evidence/selector behavior before choosing a model; obtain permission for all evaluation images.
Test approved candidate model/SDK/account capabilities, Swedish/English content, repeated stability, refusal/truncation and actual image/token/cost/latency.
Review unsupported claims, privacy and hallucinated numerical facts as critical failures; do not use longer/flatter text as a quality proxy.
Publish an approved-or-disabled generation policy with exact version identifiers, retry/cost limits and regression triggers.
tasks.contract_handoff: Evaluated model/prompt/image policy and real data-control/spend evidence, not a copied historical alias/price.
acceptance: Critical failures block activation; noncritical criteria were declared before the final evaluation.
Account-specific processing/retention support and actual costs are recorded without logging private packets.
negative_tests: No reference, conflicting rule, image/fact conflict, malicious image text, low quality, foreign evidence, new numerical assertion and late deleted-report output.
artifacts: Protected evaluation suite/results and approved generation configuration
rollback: Disable the model/prompt policy or return to a still-approved evaluated version; never regenerate saved reports automatically.

tasks.title: Interactive Free web product
coding_steps: Build fixture-backed route/state UI then integrate real capture/upload/job status and authorized report endpoints through generated clients.
Implement evidence interaction, partial/no-reference report, history, guest upgrade, logout and deletion with principal/revision-aware caches.
Keep Next handlers limited to presentation/session transport; no independent measurement, SQL or purchase authority.
Add accessible responsive layouts and explicit allowlisted analytics only; shared report components become T21 print/card inputs.
tasks.contract_handoff: Working Free web journey and reusable web report components tied to saved projections.
acceptance: Refresh/reconnect resumes the known job rather than creating work; provider-disabled Free works.
No server keys or paid hidden data in client payloads; supported browser/accessibility journeys pass.
negative_tests: Auth expiry, late prior-account response, cross-owner URL, revoked report, corrupt payload, upload failure, long labels and zero/missing charts.
artifacts: Web client and browser/accessibility contract tests
rollback: Deploy compatible presentation versions and clear unsafe caches; preserve API compatibility and saved reports.

tasks.title: Deterministic pair and history comparison
coding_steps: Implement native-unit differences, common valid masks, method/version compatibility and fixed family scales before any overall score.
Resolve the existing cosine-range/schema conflict explicitly rather than clipping a value into a probability.
Support same-owner Me-v-Me first and service contracts for separately granted partner inputs; T22 gates other-owner release.
Distinguish capture/date/task/method variation from writing change and qualify any similarity index with an evaluated mapping.
tasks.contract_handoff: ComparisonDocument fixtures with directional facts, coverage and authorized evidence for web/native/export/Premium.
acceptance: A/B swap preserves distance and reverses directional labels; self-distance is zero where defined.
Reference absence still permits valid descriptive comparisons; no authorship/romance/mental-health inference.
negative_tests: Zero variance/norm, missing overlap, incompatible methods, negative cosine, near-zero percent-change denominator and unapproved partner sample.
artifacts: Comparison use cases and invariant fixtures
rollback: Version comparison mappings and withhold incompatible summaries rather than reinterpreting old results.

tasks.title: Cross-platform purchase ledger entitlements and metered jobs
coding_steps: Create internal catalog/provider mappings, verified event inbox, unique financial transactions, immutable credit lots/ledger, reservation and fulfilment states.
Implement fake then sandbox Stripe checkout/webhooks, Apple signed/server-notification verification and Play token/RTDN verification with environment/account binding.
Grant a durable credit atomically then promptly finish/consume/acknowledge via the product-appropriate provider path; never wait for AI completion.
Reserve one eligible credit per intended Premium job; fence publication, release/compensate failure and reconcile ambiguous provider outcomes.
Implement repeated restore, refunds/voided events, account deletion and cross-platform origin-policy enforcement; backend work does not depend on native UI completion.
tasks.contract_handoff: Server-owned catalog, purchase claims/status, credit/fulfilment APIs and reconciliation workers for web/iOS/Android.
acceptance: Only verified PURCHASED/paid states grant, once per financial identity; client redirects/flags never grant.
Concurrency and crash tests prove no double spend/grant and no lost durable credit; refunds are compensating events.
negative_tests: Pending payment, wrong product/account/environment, duplicate/reordered events, grant-before-finish crash, consume timeout, last-credit race, refund after spend and replay after deletion.
artifacts: Ledger/migrations, three backend payment adapters, sandbox evidence and reconciliation runbook
rollback: Disable new sales/fulfilment safely while preserving audit and reconciliation; never delete financial history or remint restored transactions.

tasks.title: Premium and paid-pair web experience
coding_steps: Integrate a truthful offer, explicit image-provider processing permission and server catalog/credit status; no fabricated pre-generated personal teaser.
Implement purchase pending/verify/granted, job/refusal/failure/refund and saved-overlay states using real backend APIs.
Add optional paid-pair narrative and submit report-content feedback only through the T24 backend feedback API, preserving deterministic pair access without requiring two individual purchases.
Ensure panel expansion/reopen/theme/export reads saved content and never calls the model.
tasks.contract_handoff: Web paid journey/state fixtures and presentation semantics reused by native implementations.
acceptance: A failed paid generation leaves Free available with documented recovery.
Server-side paid projection and exact report/PDF content parity remain enforced.
negative_tests: Duplicate click, success redirect before verification, revoked consent, no credit, ambiguous job, account switch and paid text leakage.
artifacts: Web paywall/fulfilment/feedback UI and E2E cases
rollback: Disable offers/new generation through capabilities without hiding already authorized saved content or breaking Free.

tasks.title: Same-content PDF and share-card rendering
coding_steps: Render trusted print/card components from the authorized saved projection; expand appropriate details without adding new prose/measurements.
Create bounded render jobs, safe internal asset resolution, A4/Letter/card formats and revision/projection/template/locale cache keys.
Use selectable text/vector charts where practical, wait for approved fonts/assets, and inspect actual rendered pages for clipping/reading order.
Support user-visible image omission and native authorized file download/share handoff; no model credentials or arbitrary Internet browsing.
tasks.contract_handoff: Export request/status and scoped artifact retrieval APIs with fact-equivalent print/card assets.
acceptance: Free/Premium/pair/history facts, units, labels and qualifications match web/native projections.
Revoked access blocks new issuance and protected retrieval; downloaded copies are not falsely claimed recallable.
negative_tests: Long labels, empty charts, revoked image mid-render, malicious URL/text, oversized render, stale cache grant and missing font.
artifacts: Renderer, export APIs, parity fixtures and visual inspection evidence

tasks.title: Scoped sharing and comparison invitations
coding_steps: Implement explicit field-scoped share grants, preview, hashed opaque tokens, expiry/revocation and conservative cache/asset issuance.

Track share initiation versus actual link/invite redemption without contact harvesting or private report analytics.

Publish exact candidate evidence, unresolved critical findings and approved limitations; route defects back to owners before qualification.
tasks.contract_handoff: Independent release-candidate QA/security/privacy evidence for store readiness and T25.
acceptance: All critical disclosure/billing/factuality/security defects are closed with regressions.
Actual latency/cost/coverage/device evidence is reported, not predicted from unit tests.
negative_tests: Cross-account purchase/report, stale lease/deletion, restore resurrection, revoked partner, prompt injection, resource exhaustion and delayed store notification.
artifacts: Threat model, test results and candidate review disposition
rollback: Block release and return failing capabilities to their owners; no waiver by hiding a failed test.

tasks.title: Deployment recovery support and notifications
coding_steps: Deploy staging and approved production topology with narrow worker roles, migrations, private storage, secret rotation and independent capability kill switches.

Implement the authenticated report-feedback API, minimal/redacted persistence, retention/deletion lifecycle and restricted support-review access; feedback is not a telemetry event and may not include raw handwriting or unrestricted report payloads.
Exercise backups/restore with deletion tombstones, durable job/payment reconciliation, model outage, cost limits and compatible mobile/API rollout.
Write actionable incident/refund/deletion/key compromise/store halt and version rollback runbooks with actual deployed commands and support responsibility.
tasks.contract_handoff: Operable staged infrastructure and recovery/notification/support evidence, not public release approval.
acceptance: A restore cannot resurrect erased data or duplicate credits/provider calls.
Provider outage preserves Free and safe business state; no private writing in dashboards or crash logs.
Report feedback is owner/report-bound, redacted to an allowlisted contract, removable under the approved lifecycle and inaccessible to generic analytics/telemetry roles.
negative_tests: Mail/push outage, queue restoration, stale token, budget breaker, key revocation, expired DB connection, refund reconciliation and rollback to withdrawn benchmark.
Feedback containing raw writing/full report payload, cross-owner report feedback, support-role overreach, duplicate submission, and deletion followed by backup/queue resurrection.
artifacts: Deployment manifests, notification adapters, dashboards and tested runbooks
rollback: Promote only tested compatible artifacts; preserve tombstones and immutable ledger while halting affected capabilities.
